Hi Sofie —

Thanks again for your time today. As discussed, attaching an initial MAP (MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out the milestones, ownership, and dependencies we sketched on the call. High-level asks inside:

- Target commercial close: 2026-08-20 (we flagged procurement runway of ~3–4 weeks)
- Procurement / PO signature target: 2026-08-10 (to allow downstream onboarding)
- Milestone owners: Novafin owns legal & procurement; Redwood to deliver technical validation and SOW draft

Can you confirm the names for procurement + legal we should loop into the MAP? Also, is the 8/10 signature runway feasible for your internal calendar? If not, let us know the hard-block dates so we can propose alternate rollout lanes.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement/legal owners (by 7/23)
2) Redwood delivers SOW-draft and cost model (attached PDF & docx) — 7/26
3) Joint exec sync (15–20 minutes) week of 7/27 to sign off on MAP and close date

Attaching: MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), redwood-econ-model.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Thanks — I’ll hold the joint exec slot tentatively for 7/28 morning PT.
